title: Veterans Pension Housebound, Aid and Attendance and Dependent Rate Categories
content:
# Rate category changes for care level and dependents — Veterans Pension

**Care level.** An aid-and-attendance or housebound rate category is granted only on a physician's examination report where the category requires one. Housebound status needs a single permanent disability rated 100 percent plus either a separate disability rated 60 percent or more, or permanent confinement to the home; a veteran who meets aid-and-attendance criteria is paid at the aid-and-attendance rate instead.

**Dependents.** Moving between a no-dependent and a one-dependent category requires a dependency claim received online or by mail, effective on the marriage or birth date when the claim arrives within 365 days of it and on the claim date otherwise. A child counts until the 18th birthday, or the 23rd birthday while in school.

**Payment of a higher category.** A higher category is paid from the month after its effective date, with months already paid at the lower rate released as a retroactive payment.

## Housebound status — combinations

| Single permanent disability rated 100 percent | Separate disability rated 60 percent or more | Permanently confined to the home | Housebound status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | not needed | met |
| Yes | No | Yes | met |
| Yes | No | No | not met |
| No | — | — | not met |

A veteran who also meets aid-and-attendance criteria is paid at the aid-and-attendance rate rather than the housebound rate.

## Effective date of a dependency claim (hypothetical dates)

| Event | Claim received | Effective date |
|---|---|---|
| Marriage on June 10, 2025 | June 10, 2026 (within 365 days) | June 10, 2025 |
| Marriage on June 10, 2025 | September 1, 2026 (after 365 days) | September 1, 2026 |

A claim made by telephone does not meet the requirement, which names a claim received online or by mail.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A veteran moves from Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, No Dependents) to Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, One Dependent) effective March 12. The higher category is paid from April; if April and May were already paid at the lower rate, those two months are released together as a retroactive payment of the difference.
